items.stem: Which service is best for decoupling a producer from multiple downstream consumers by events?

options.rationale: Correct: EventBridge routes events to multiple targets, decoupling producers and consumers.
EC2 is compute, not an event router.
S3 is storage; it is not an event-routing bus.
IAM manages access, not event routing.

items.stem: Which TWO handle failures in asynchronous serverless processing? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Configure a dead-letter queue for messages that keep failing
options.rationale: Correct: a DLQ captures messages after retries are exhausted.

options.text: Delete the function on first error
options.rationale: Deleting the function stops all processing.

options.text: Ignore errors and hope they resolve

items.explanation: Correct: retries and a DLQ handle async failures.

items.stem: Which workload is the weakest fit for AWS Lambda?

options.text: A long-running job that runs for hours continuously
options.rationale: Correct: very long continuous jobs exceed Lambda's model and limits.
Short event-driven work fits Lambda well.

items.explanation: Correct: hours-long continuous jobs fit Lambda poorly.
